title: Together, we help our community thrive.
intro: A place to connect, lend a hand, and have a voice. Welcome to the Thrive Center for Success Parent–Teacher Organization.
imageAlt: Illustrated school garden with a tree, a welcoming bench, and colorful classroom windows. Temporary artwork, not a photograph of the Thrive campus.
pathsIntro: Find the way to get involved that works for you and your family.
eventsTitle: Good things to look forward to
eventsIntro: Keep an eye here for upcoming PTO events and ways to connect.
volunteerTitle: An hour. A helping hand. A difference.
volunteerIntro: Volunteers help make so many of the special moments at Thrive possible. Whether you have an hour to give or want to take on a larger role, we'd love to have you join us—but there's never any pressure. Every contribution is appreciated.
membershipTitle: Have a voice in what comes next.
membershipIntro: Some important PTO decisions and changes require a membership vote. Your membership gives you a voice in those decisions.
contactIntro: Questions about the PTO or your membership? We're here to help.
